Boyfriend, alternatively referred to as The Boyfriend or shortened to BF, is the protagonist of Friday Night Funkin'. He is a young singer and rapper whose main goal is to gain approval to date Girlfriend, but he must sing off against her evil ex-rockstar father, Daddy Dearest, his popstar wife Mommy Mearest, and many other characters that stand in his way.

Boyfriend is portrayed as a young, overzealous rapper with a love for music, donuts, and his girlfriend. He loves to sing and show off his skills, resulting in his confident and cocky character. He is very determined and persistent about reaching his goals and won't let anyone get in the way of his success, even when threatened with death. Despite his cockiness and confidence, Boyfriend is quite sensitive, as he was easily stunned by Tankman's insults, as seen in the cutscene for Stress.

Boyfriend is implied to be clingy, as he is never seen without Girlfriend by his side. He is also very unintelligent, as he either does not realize when he is in danger or becomes overconfident in his ability to get to safety. As a result, he is essentially fearless. This is demonstrated during both Monster and Winter Horrorland, where he does not appear to be afraid despite Monster's constant threatening towards him and Girlfriend. However, he isn't incapable of feeling fear, as he is extremely astraphobic, meaning he's afraid of lightning. Boyfriend also shows that he gets bored of scary games, as he once almost fell asleep while playing one. Despite his stupidity, Boyfriend is not completely devoid of intelligence; having street smarts, he knows how to heal people, and also has good intuition.

Boyfriend seems quite willing to do immoral things. From tricking iPad children on YouTube for money and cigarettes, getting as much free food as possible from McDonald's while holding the store hostage, hogging up drive-throughs, and vandalizing PlayPlaces, Boyfriend does not appear to care if the things he does are wrong as long as he can get what he wants. In addition, he appears to be somewhat destructive and influenced by anger, as whenever his phones fail to work properly, his first instinct is to destroy them in bizarre and extreme ways. Boyfriend is not without morals, however, as he can be friendly with others, such as Skid and Pump, although he wouldn't hesitate to curse in front of them.

Information about The Darkness corruption: The Darkness is a goo substance capable of infecting everything around its path...Any beings that is corrupted, gives a permanent twisted creeply smile with completely pupilsless white eyes, becoming a mindless zombies with goo oozing around the victim depending on who has black goo (not completely all over the body, but if someone has goo oozing in any part of the body, you can already tell that the person is infected). The Darkness is a black liquidy substance that flashes different colors, like multicolored-fast-pixelated around its glitching black goo. The Darkness (also known as The Glitch or The Corruption) is the main antagonist of Learning With Pibby: Apocalypse. It is a glitchy, rampaging ink-like blob of darkness with ear-piercing glitch noise’s that assimilates everything in its path and whose origin is unknown. All that is known about it is that it’s a mindless force that seemingly targets cartoons and turns all characters it assimilates into mindless zombies that it uses to spread its influence. Darkness's appearance is mostly depicted as an amalgamation of its victims. The Darkness's main body consist of a glitching substance (it could be ink or black slime, but it's currently unknown.) that consumes and assimilates the various characters it encounters. It is partially made up of colorful pixels that move at a rapid speed. The Darkness, is a goo substance capable of infecting everything as a Apocalypse, a rampaging ink-like blob that destroys everything in its path, particularly cartoon shows, games or even multiverses. It is a glitchy, black substance which turns cartoon characters into mindless zombies that are forced to smile. The Darkness seemingly has no mind of it's own, simply causing and destruction all around its area, making glitch sounds as it approaches its victims.

The Darkness is a mysterious and nigh-unstoppable mass of glitchy darkness that assimilates and corrupts everything in its path. It corrupts fictional characters by assimilating them into becoming its zombified slaves who haves an twisted, permanent creeply smile losing their pupils in their eyes who love and worship it as a benevolent deity, before proceeding to assimilate their entire world.

Boyfriend wants to talk the others into joining with him, saying is so fun and blissful being corrupted by The Darkness.

Boyfriend's Illusionist Power, while he is corrupted: While corrupted by The Darkness, Boyfriend can create illusion of his past, unaffected self for small periods of times, mostly for 30-40 seconds typically, but don't take that timeframe as fact. Boyfriend cannot make illusions of others survivors, only himself, being his old unaffected self, but he can only make illusion of him being a survivor. Boyfriend can basically create an illusion of his own past, unaffected person (not perfect though). He mainly do this to trick and scare his victims, before attacking or chasing them, since he's an illusionist. He can only creates the most simple illusion of himself. Boyfriend can't even create some other stuff. He also has trouble maintaining any illusion for long, usually. He's still an illusionist in this corrupted form, but a mindless, chaotic zombie type one.

While corrupted, Boyfriend's powers is creating illusions based on his own appearance as an individual, with minor changes (longer limbs, bigger smiling mouth, and etc). He can also make himself smaller, by how he likes (he tends to make taller when fighting or making his victims panic). But it's not very stable, and he cannot create any other type of illusion (like an object). This Corrupted Boyfriend only has few simple-level powers as an illusionist. 

Boyfriend's mind and soul are already corrupted and assimilated to The Darkness, his mind is now mindless and chaotic under the entity's evil control. He does not care or think about his former self or any other person. He's just here to consume other people with The Darkness like he did. He's like an undead mindless zombie but with powers of being an illusionist.

Boyfriend wants to infect unaffected people to bring them eternal happiness, without inject something like syringe, since The Darkness is contagious by its own corruption through black multicolored-fast-pixelated glitchy goo.

Boyfriend loves hugs, and also likes to Embrace unaffected people to become corrupted like Boyfriend. Boyfriend just wants to bring happiness to everyone who hasn't yet been corrupted by The Darkness.

When Boyfriend can hugs anyone, he can puts the unaffected person in The Darkness black multicolored-fast-pixelated glitching ooze covered around in Boyfriend's own mouth, making an vomit-like ooze in his own mouth to the victim's face and mouth, so that the infection spreads further quickly into the victim.

While corrupted, Boyfriend can do vomits-like of his drooling black multicolored-fast pixelated ooze corruption in his own twisted mouth when embracing anyone who isn't corrupted yet by The Darkness, aka unaffected one.

Boyfriend is contagious through physical contact, and that the corruption can quickly spread to its victims if they touch Boyfriend covered in black multicolored-fast-pixelated glitching ooze corruption around some parts of his body, including his hands.

While corrupted, Boyfriend can withstand any form of physical attack, including bullets, swords, or even frying pans.

Once Boyfriend can manages to corrupt his victims feeling The Darkness ooze corruption in any part of Boyfriend's body, the affected victims can forms an twisted, permanent disproportionate stretched tooth-less smile, and the victim's eyes will lose its pupils, forming an pure pupils-less white eyes, becoming corrupted by The Darkness corruption surrounded their mind.
